original_evidence.text: | Varia | https://github.com/giantpinkrobots/varia | 7624b5d / 2026-08-19 | Y | N (opt-in toggle `check_for_updates_on_startup_enabled`, default `'0'`; Windows/Mac only) | **Y** | https (github.com / api.github.com via aria2c CLI; no `--check-certificate=false` seen, default aria2c cert validation applies) | N | **none** | none | `src/window/updater.py:50-52` fetches `https://api.github.com/repos/giantpinkrobots/varia/releases` via `aria2c` subprocess; `:87,91` build `binary_url` = `https://github.com/.../releases/download/<tag>/varia-windows-setup-amd64.exe` (or `.dmg`); `:170-177` download the installer via `aria2c` with **no hash/signature check anywhere in the file**; `src/variamain.py:571-575` then directly executes it: `subprocess.Popen([self.update_executable, "/SILENT", ...])` (Win) / `subprocess.call(('open', self.update_executable))` (Mac). |
